business_problem: Seasonal challenges, like hot summers or high number of travelers during vacation periods, lead to increased demand while windy winters cause disruptions.
solution_summary: Aydem Energy used Azure OpenAI Service, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as WhatsApp, CRM and ERP systems, Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. 90% of inquiries are fully resolved, boosting agent and customer satisfaction and creating new revenue opportunities.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
business_outcome: 90% of inquiries are fully resolved, boosting agent and customer satisfaction and creating new revenue opportunities.
